question: Have monkeys gone to space?
short_answer: Yes, monkeys (including rhesus macaques, squirrel monkeys, and cynomolgus monkeys) were launched into space by the U.S., Soviet Union, France, and Iran between 1948 and 2013 to study physiological stress.
full_explanation: On May 28, 1959, Jupiter AM-18 carried rhesus monkey Able and squirrel monkey Miss Baker to an altitude of 300 miles. Both survived the suborbital flight, making Miss Baker a famous space survivor who lived until 1984.
